# Clipwharf

> Local-only clipboard history for macOS. Menu-bar app, Swift/SwiftPM, no
> dependencies, no network, no telemetry.

- [README.md](README.md) — features, install, usage, permissions, FAQ (English)
  - [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Français](README.fr.md) · [Español](README.es.md)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — step-by-step instructions for coding agents that
  build/install the app
- [docs/ai-install.md](docs/ai-install.md) — copy-paste prompts to install with
  Claude Code / Codex / Cursor
- [docs/distribution.md](docs/distribution.md) — Developer ID signing, notarization,

- [STATUS.md](STATUS.md) — implementation status and scope decisions

## Build in three lines

```sh
git clone https://github.com/JesseWeb/Clipwharf.git && cd Clipwharf
./scripts/make-app.sh release
open dist/Clipwharf.app
```

Requirements: macOS 13+, Xcode 15+ (Swift 5.9+). The app is a menu-bar agent
(`LSUIElement`): no Dock icon, no main window. Press ⌘⇧V to open the history
strip. Auto-paste needs the Accessibility permission.
